title: Loot table
description: The floor-band loot table of one dungeon (03-GAME-DESIGN §6.2 drop shape, §8.3 in-dungeon chests; the rows of 08-ITEMS.md §11): gold per fight, the gear chance, the grade shape, part and consumable odds, and the treasure room. One file per band under content/loot-tables/<id>.json; a floor finds its table by dungeonId and floorBand. Boss drops live on the boss monster (boss.everyKill / boss.firstKill); bossFirstKill names which monster's lines apply on the band's boss floor.

floorBand.description: Dungeon floors this table covers; the linter checks a dungeon's tables tile its floors.

monsterLevels.description: The band's monster levels, for the card.

goldRange.description: Gold per fight before multipliers (08 §11: Cellars 10–20).

itemChance.description: Chance per fight of a gear item (weapon, armor, trinket); elites always drop one.

gradeShape.description: The floor-drop shape around the band's centre grade (08 §11: centre 55 · −1 25 · +1 14 · +2 5 · +3 1), with a missing lower grade folded into the centre (the Cellars: F 80 · E 14 · D 5 · C 1). The linter checks the five numbers sum to 100 and that no line reaches God.

partChance.description: Per monster (§6.5): the common part and the rare part.

stoneChance.description: Chance per fight of a generic +N stone of the band (08 §11: 8).

consumableDrop.description: Chance per fight of one consumable from the band's list.

treasureRoom.description: The strongroom (07 §2.7, 08 §11): gold piles, the guaranteed Small chest, the Large chest and its lock, the trap, the consumable bundle and the hidden find.

goldFightsWorth.description: The piles together are worth this many fights' gold (2).

smallChestChance.description: A Small chest is present (100 = guaranteed).

largeChestChance.description: A Large chest is present as well (20).

largeLockedChance.description: Of Large chests, the share that are locked (50).

trappedChance.description: Share of chests here that are trapped (07 §2.7: Cellars 20, Crypts 30, Vault 40).

trapId.description: The dungeon trap a trapped chest springs (Spring Spikes); null for none.

consumableBundle.description: Items in the consumable bundle, from the band's consumable list (3).

hiddenFind.description: The Detection find: an extra item at +1 shape, or a Skeleton Key.

darknessItemBonus.description: Item chance × (1 + bonus) by light band (§4.2, 08 §11: dim +10, shadowy +25, dark +50, pitch +75), band → percent.

bossFirstKill.description: The boss monster whose boss.everyKill and boss.firstKill lines close this band (the Grinning Captain for floors 1–3); null for a band with no boss floor.
